R1_resolution.evidence: The subclass now clears guard.record and calls guard.observer.begin(False) before delegating once to the parent initialize. begin(False) resets enabled/calls/record while retaining the installed predictor wrapper. The parent still initializes direct E0 once and rebuilds anchor/initial templates/last_m2.
R1_resolution.verification: Supplied regression uses real E0Observation.begin with parent initialize mocked. Additional reviewer lifecycle probe uses actual M1TemplateGuard and E0Observation with synthetic FakeTracker/FakeE0: track a lost frame, initialize another sequence, verify empty guard/observer records and zero calls/disabled capture, then track an off-cadence new-sequence frame and verify a fresh M1 record and one predictor call. Parent base initialization and stub anchor construction each occur once; close restores original predict.

initial_observer_installation.evidence: Guard wraps the direct base tracker after inherited M2 loading. Observer starts disabled and initialization explicitly disables/resets it. Inherited anchor construction uses encode, not predict, so it does not cause an extra E0/M1 decision. Checkpoint/CUDA/real encoder construction was not executed by this review.

sequence_reset.evidence: M1 diagnostics reset before inherited base frame/counter/history/anchor/templates/last_m2 reset. The existing caller contract still requires set_sequence for each sequence. Observer ownership is preserved across initialization; close ends that ownership.

gate_and_cadence.evidence: guard.track runs direct E0 once and computes current-frame M1 before gating. Candidate generation requires state==2 and inherited sampled-frame membership. Candidate previous box is captured before E0 and initial templates are used. Non-lost/off-cadence paths return the exact guarded E0 box/route objects.
gate_and_cadence.qualification: Cadence samples every25th positive valid frame. Consecutive full-style valid indices yield1,26,51,...; irregular TRAIN lists need not. This review admits no full evaluation.

guard_semantics.evidence: M1 executes every tracked frame. Uncertain and lost states can block E0 dynamic-template writes even off the M2 cadence; only lost can invoke M2. Therefore non-recovery preserves M1-guarded E0, not unguarded E0 template behavior.

no_match.evidence: Index0 retains guarded E0 state/history/templates/counters and exact box/route objects; last_m2 correctly records invocation and class0. No-match remains candidate-set rejection, not a trained relative E0-preservation score.

positive_candidate.evidence: Replaces box and rebuilds history from replacement geometry and pre-E0 previous state. Performs no replacement template crop/write. M1's prior lost-state template rollback is retained, including at forced divisible-by5 TRAIN-style invocation frames.

frame_since_query_history_geometry.evidence: Direct E0 increments frame once and updates since_query once. Action1 already resets since_query and action0 already increments it; positive replacement preserves that result and stores it divided by100. Motion uses old/new centers normalized by previous width/height; scale uses log(new size/previous size). Omitting R15's redundant action1 reset is correct.

close.evidence: guard.close restores original model.predict; the real observer probe confirms this beyond the supplied Mock delegation test.
